limitations: Hashes record repository bytes inspected during packaging; hosted code is not included or executed.
Installed validation checks local client bytes and this retained review declaration.
Hosted deployment, live controls and model delivery require separate acceptance evidence.

classes.content: Generated or supplied answer, including a Deep Research report, memo, or one-page letter; answer contract; claims and surrounding text; citations; normalized captured text from fetched public pages or local source files, including extracted PDF page text and page-coverage status, and HTML text parsed without tag attributes, comments, scripts or styles; source-identity, semantic-support, reasoning, issue-treatment, disposition, and professional-judgment assessments; diagnostics; proposed corrections and review decisions. The canonical review record keeps each claim or scope assessment once and uses local references for mechanical observations and the complete audit rather than duplicating those records in each review item. Stable source resource IDs, selected capture IDs, immutable original bytes and extracted text, exact inventory revisions, passage types and actual original-inspection notes, pinned treatment evidence/effects and issue dependencies may be selected for the same host-model review. Developer evaluation records can retain the actual question, materials, research history, delivered answer, host/model/tool observations, package identity and assessor judgment locally; no evaluation helper calls a model or sends evidence externally. Vera delivers the reviewed answer, sources and material unresolved choices directly. Its opinion delivery policy removes the answer-review panel and per-record approval queue; compatibility payloads remain local internal artifacts, and actual substantive feedback remains in the research issue register.
classes.purpose: Assess answer-contract conformance, claim coverage, source identity, semantic support, reasoning quality, professional-judgment boundaries, and proposed corrections

classes.content: Only when the contracted adversarial policy is required for a concrete opinion or an explicit opposing-opinion request. Informational research alone does not create this phase. Complete reviewed original opinion, material case facts, original answer contract, sources and validation limits; actual research queries and selected public source texts; complete opposing opinion or reasoned negative or evidence-limited result; source, support, reasoning and professional-judgment reviews; search record, comparison and its semantic review. The same selected model runtime may perform every phase. Local code hashes phase files and checks structure and declared states; it does not generate legal arguments or choose an outcome.
classes.purpose: Develop and review a substantive opposing case independently of the original validation outcome and compare both positions

classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested

classes.content: Selected full source files and their locally prepared views may enter the native model context under this workflow's existing interpretation/review phases. The task has a distinct task ID, source filenames, exact-byte receipts, purpose, and output paths without an archive/client identity. The local capture helper makes no model or external-service call. Sources and outputs remain in the selected task folder until the user removes them; provider/host retention is separate. No automatic anonymization is performed. The existing Vera model-data report and minimal server-stamping service still apply when those commands are used.
classes.purpose: Retain one explicitly selected standalone deliverable without registering a client

classes.content: Accepted brief and answer contract; selected case materials; actual public queries, results and opened authority passages; version/date metadata, adverse evidence and access limits; provisional conclusions, source support, applicability and reasoning assessments; challenges and responses; persistent material-issue and cycle records; changed and dependent conclusions; coverage and stopping assessments; final-validation and opposing-review feedback that reopens research. These may enter the selected host model context; no separate model API or automatic anonymization is added.
classes.purpose: Investigate, validate and challenge the prepared legal/tax question throughout research in Vera or Lucia

classes.content: Saved provider choices and bounded reported access metadata; actual research queries, returned results, document titles, citable links, source passages, adverse evidence, applicability assessments and access/retention limitations can enter the selected host model context. The profile-local helper makes no browser, network or model call and stores no document bodies or credentials.
classes.purpose: Use the user-authorised subscription evidence within the existing legal and tax assignment

classes.content: Optional recommended and observed model identifiers, the capability-selection basis, host/session reference, source of identity evidence, voluntary user statements from chat or the legacy confirmation tool, and actual phase-assignment references. This local record may enter the current host model context. It contains no credentials and is not model-provider attestation. Cowork can use the same managed Python helper and chat without UI or an external model API.
classes.purpose: Record Vera's advisory model preference and truthful model provenance without blocking the legal/tax pipeline

de:
Deterministischer Code liest das vollständige Dokument, keine Stichprobe, und speichert den vollständig extrahierten Text. Die Navigationsinventare sind auf 40 Überschriften, 80 mögliche Aussagen, 200 rohe URLs und 200 Zitatmarkierungen begrenzt; Markdown-Links und Fußnoten bleiben vollständig, sodass jede unterschiedliche aus dem Dokument extrahierte HTTP/S-URL abgerufen werden kann. Für jede URL akzeptiert der Code nur öffentliche Ziele auf Standardports, liest höchstens 1.000.001 Bytes zur Erkennung einer Kürzung und behält die ersten 1.000.000; ohne Netzwerkabruf verwendet er die aufgelisteten Verweise und ausgewählten lokalen Dateien, deren vollständiger Text gelesen wird. Der öffentliche Host erhält die URL und Anfragemetadaten.

Das Modell liest das vollständige Dokument, den Antwortvertrag, wesentliche Aussagen mit Kontext, Zitate, das Quelleninventar und den benötigten erfassten Text sowie Bewertungen von Quellenidentität und -stützung, Begründung, professionellem Ermessen und Korrekturen. Die Unterlagen können Namen, personenbezogene sowie rechtliche, steuerliche oder finanzielle Informationen enthalten. Es erfolgt keine automatische Anonymisierung oder Pseudonymisierung: Parteien- und Quellenidentität sowie exakte Fakten können für die Validierung erforderlich sein. Die Grenze möglicher Aussagen beschränkt weder die semantische Auswahl noch den erklärten Prüfumfang; zur Korrektur kann das Modell die geprüften Aussagen und das vollständige Dokument erneut erhalten.

Um wiederholte Übertragungen zu vermeiden, erreichen die Daten der Prüfung das Modell nur einmal, wenn die Prüfungsansicht geöffnet wird. Die Ansicht zeigt bis zu 750 Aussagen und kann höchstens 2.500 Elemente oder 2 MB empfangen; alle Aussagen und Kontrollen bleiben in den Arbeitsdateien verfügbar. Der für die Prüfung verwendete temporäre Verweis bleibt vier Stunden im Arbeitsspeicher. Wenn die Prüfungsansicht nicht verfügbar ist, liest das Modell dieselben Dateien direkt; nur ältere oder nicht verwaltete Pakete können weiterhin alle Daten zusammen senden. Quellen mit identischem Inhalt werden einmal gespeichert, ohne ihre URLs oder Herkunftsangaben zu verlieren.
en:
Deterministic code reads the complete document, not a sample, and stores the complete extracted text. Navigation inventories are capped at 40 headings, 80 candidate claims, 200 raw URLs, and 200 citation markers; Markdown links and footnotes remain complete, so every distinct HTTP/S URL extracted from the document may be fetched. For each URL, code accepts only public destinations on standard ports, reads at most 1,000,001 bytes to detect truncation, and retains the first 1,000,000; without network fetching it uses the listed references and selected local files, whose complete text is read. The public host receives the URL and request metadata.

The model reads the complete document, answer contract, material claims with surrounding text, citations, source inventory, and needed captured text, together with assessments of source identity and support, reasoning, professional judgment, and corrections. The material may contain names, personal details, and legal, tax, or financial information. No automatic anonymization or pseudonymization is applied: party and source identity and exact facts may be necessary to validation. The candidate-claim cap does not limit semantic selection or declared coverage; to correct the result, the model may receive the reviewed claims and complete document again.

To avoid repeated transfers, the review data reaches the model only once, when the review screen opens. The screen shows up to 750 claims and can receive at most 2,500 items or 2 MB; every claim and check remains available in the working files. The temporary link used for the review stays in memory for four hours. If the review screen is unavailable, the model reads the same files directly; only older or unmanaged packages may still send all the data together. Sources with identical content are stored once, without losing their URLs or provenance.
es:
El código determinista lee el documento completo, no una muestra, y guarda todo el texto extraído. Los inventarios de navegación se limitan a 40 títulos, 80 afirmaciones candidatas, 200 URL sin procesar y 200 marcadores de cita; los enlaces Markdown y las notas permanecen completos, por lo que puede recuperarse cada URL HTTP/S distinta extraída del documento. Para cada URL, el código solo admite destinos públicos en puertos estándar, lee como máximo 1.000.001 bytes para detectar truncamientos y conserva el primer 1.000.000; sin recuperación de red usa las referencias enumeradas y los archivos locales seleccionados, cuyo texto completo se lee. El host público recibe la URL y los metadatos de la solicitud.

El modelo lee el documento completo, el contrato de respuesta, las afirmaciones materiales con su contexto, las citas, el inventario de fuentes y el texto obtenido que sea necesario, además de las evaluaciones de identidad y respaldo de las fuentes, razonamiento, juicio profesional y correcciones. Los materiales pueden contener nombres, datos personales e información jurídica, fiscal o financiera. No se aplica anonimización ni seudonimización automática: la identidad de las partes y de las fuentes y los hechos exactos pueden ser necesarios para la validación. El límite de afirmaciones candidatas no limita la selección semántica ni la cobertura declarada; para corregir el resultado, el modelo puede recibir de nuevo las afirmaciones revisadas y el documento completo.

Para evitar envíos repetidos, los datos de la revisión llegan al modelo una sola vez, al abrir la pantalla de revisión. La pantalla muestra hasta 750 afirmaciones y puede recibir como máximo 2.500 elementos o 2 MB; todas las afirmaciones y comprobaciones siguen disponibles en los archivos de trabajo. El enlace temporal usado para la revisión permanece en memoria durante cuatro horas. Si la pantalla de revisión no está disponible, el modelo lee directamente los mismos archivos; solo los paquetes antiguos o no gestionados pueden seguir enviando todos los datos juntos. Las fuentes con contenido idéntico se guardan una sola vez, sin perder sus URL ni su procedencia.
fr:
Le code déterministe lit le document complet, et non un échantillon, puis conserve tout le texte extrait. Les inventaires de navigation sont limités à 40 titres, 80 affirmations candidates, 200 URL brutes et 200 marqueurs de citation ; les liens Markdown et les notes restent complets, de sorte que chaque URL HTTP/S distincte extraite du document peut être récupérée. Pour chaque URL, le code n'accepte que des destinations publiques sur les ports standard, lit au plus 1 000 001 octets pour détecter la troncature et conserve les 1 000 000 premiers ; sans récupération réseau, il utilise les références listées et les fichiers locaux sélectionnés, dont le texte complet est lu. L'hôte public reçoit l'URL et les métadonnées de la requête.

Le modèle lit le document complet, le contrat de réponse, les affirmations matérielles avec leur contexte, les citations, l'inventaire des sources et le texte recueilli nécessaire, ainsi que les évaluations d'identité et de support des sources, du raisonnement, du jugement professionnel et des corrections. Les éléments peuvent contenir des noms, des données personnelles et des informations juridiques, fiscales ou financières. Aucune anonymisation ni pseudonymisation automatique n'est appliquée : l'identité des parties et des sources ainsi que les faits exacts peuvent être nécessaires à la validation. La limite des affirmations candidates ne borne ni la sélection sémantique ni la couverture déclarée ; pour corriger le résultat, le modèle peut recevoir à nouveau les affirmations revues et le document complet.

Pour éviter les envois répétés, les données de la revue parviennent au modèle une seule fois, à l’ouverture de l’écran de revue. L’écran affiche jusqu’à 750 affirmations et peut recevoir au plus 2 500 éléments ou 2 Mo ; toutes les affirmations et tous les contrôles restent disponibles dans les fichiers de travail. Le lien temporaire utilisé pour la revue reste en mémoire pendant quatre heures. Si l’écran de revue n’est pas disponible, le modèle lit directement les mêmes fichiers ; seuls les paquets anciens ou non gérés peuvent encore envoyer toutes les données ensemble. Les sources au contenu identique ne sont enregistrées qu’une fois, sans perdre leurs URL ni leur provenance.
it:
Il codice deterministico legge l'intero documento, non un campione, e salva il testo estratto completo. Gli inventari di navigazione sono limitati a 40 titoli, 80 possibili affermazioni, 200 URL grezzi e 200 marcatori di citazione; link Markdown e note restano completi, quindi possono essere recuperati tutti gli URL HTTP/S distinti ricavati dal documento. Per ogni URL il codice accetta solo destinazioni pubbliche su porte standard, legge al massimo 1.000.001 byte per rilevare il troncamento e conserva i primi 1.000.000; senza recupero di rete usa i riferimenti elencati e i file locali selezionati, dei quali legge il testo completo. L'host pubblico riceve l'URL e i metadati della richiesta.

Il modello legge il documento completo, il contratto di risposta, le affermazioni materiali con il loro contesto, le citazioni, l'inventario delle fonti e il testo acquisito necessario, oltre alle valutazioni su identità e supporto delle fonti, ragionamento, giudizio professionale e correzioni. I materiali possono contenere nomi, dati personali e informazioni legali, fiscali o finanziarie. Non vengono applicate anonimizzazione o pseudonimizzazione automatiche: identità delle parti, della fonte e fatti esatti possono essere necessari alla verifica. Il limite delle affermazioni candidate non limita la selezione semantica né la copertura dichiarata; per correggere il risultato il modello può ricevere nuovamente le affermazioni rivedute e il documento completo.

Per evitare invii ripetuti, i dati della revisione arrivano al modello una sola volta, quando si apre la schermata. La schermata mostra fino a 750 affermazioni e può ricevere al massimo 2.500 elementi o 2 MB; tutte le affermazioni e i controlli restano comunque disponibili nei file di lavoro. Il collegamento temporaneo usato per la revisione resta in memoria per quattro ore. Se la schermata non è disponibile, il modello legge direttamente gli stessi file; solo i pacchetti meno recenti o non gestiti possono ancora inviare tutti i dati insieme. Le fonti con lo stesso contenuto vengono salvate una sola volta, senza perdere URL e provenienza.

security_controls.control: Document inspection, source inspection, and packaging require a digest-valid Studio Archive deep-research-validator context, accept local evidence only from that engagement, and write only to the context's run output root or a descendant.

Initial and redirected HTTP/S URLs are restricted to standard ports without URL credentials. The connection resolves and validates every candidate address immediately before connecting directly to a checked numeric socket address; non-public addresses are rejected. TLS retains the original hostname for certificate validation and SNI. Environment proxies are disabled for this public-source route.

Legacy/shared-component capability only: Vera no longer exposes the answer-review MCP service or invokes this UI route. final_artifacts.json binds the canonical review_payload.json with SHA-256. In Codex or Cowork, when local MCP is callable, validation can reload that regular local file through the managed run reference and issue a random, in-memory, four-hour token, so render/save/apply do not require the complete payload to be resent at every step. Without local MCP, both runtimes consume the same canonical local review records and keep decisions pending unless persisted artifacts prove save and apply; unmanaged or legacy runs may still use an inline payload.

Normalized source captures with identical SHA-256 content reuse one canonical local text file. Every source record, URL, retrieval result, and duplicate-content alias remains in source_inventory.json so provenance and professional source review are preserved.

Legacy/shared-component capability only: Vera no longer exposes the answer-review MCP service or invokes this UI route. The local review server requires the session token for output downloads. It accepts only files declared by the local run, within its output directory, rejects symlinks and traversal, and limits downloads to 50 MB. Files are downloaded as opaque bytes; HTML is not executed in the review origin. This does not claim atomic protection from concurrent filesystem changes. The browser may retain a user-requested downloaded copy; this route does not send document content to the model or an external service.

The opinion CLI requires the existing deep-research-validator Studio Archive context. Fixed phase directories stay beneath its output root; traversal and symlink artifacts are rejected. Preparation binds every original phase file; delivery binds both packages and the comparison. Verification rejects changed, missing or newly added phase files and recomputes both validation records. Hashes establish local integrity, not provider attestation or legal correctness.

Legacy/shared-component capability only: Vera no longer exposes the answer-review MCP service or invokes this UI route. The local review server requests component-only private review metadata only for the registered render tool. The browser receives that payload locally; normal MCP callers continue to receive structuredContent. This is transport separation, not anonymization of data selected for model review. Reload restores the persisted applied decisions for the same plugin and run through the existing browser path sanitization. It does not apply decisions again or change the external routes. Read-only local rendering accepts validated running, review-ready and completed contexts; Save/Apply still require a running context. Nested result folders resolve the owning portable run and validate the exact requested descendant before rendering. Archived views also show a localized read-only notice and disable Save/Apply; server-side write validation remains authoritative.

Only invoice-xml, prompt-optimizer and deep-research-validator accept the distinct standalone context. The loader rechecks its digest, selected byte receipts and closed input set and rejects foreign workflows, aliases, source changes and output escape. Invoice professional export approval, schema/arithmetic checks and legal semantic review are retained. The task is not an Archive run or registered client.

The research helper requires the existing managed validation context and running status for binding. It rejects traversal and symlink artifacts, hashes the declared issue/cycle record and exact answer, contract, review, research log and retained source captures, and rejects changes on read-only verification. It checks declared treatment and record references only; it cannot certify semantic support, completeness, legal correctness or the quality of stopping.

The native review projects existing issue/cycle records, source captures, both available reviewed opinions and their comparison. Save/Apply rechecks the exact local source hashes as well as the review payload, so a stale screen cannot approve changed evidence. Reviewer decisions persist and feed the model-led issue loop; UI acceptance does not certify legal support or close unfinished research. Prior decision revisions remain in local review history. The MCP Apps bridge checks the parent window and pins its origin; window.openai is a feature-detected compatibility fallback. No new external recipient, model API, automatic anonymization or source selection is added.

Source review previews decode UTF-8 without modifying original captures. Unsupported source encodings remain explicit metadata limits; full original-byte hashes still bind review decisions. Required control records remain strict UTF-8.

Capture storage appends exact original and extracted bytes with persistent resource IDs under an OS lock, retains inventory revisions and verifies hashes before consuming evidence. Packaging rejects a different delivered answer before writing. Issue closure resolves pinned evidence/effects, reruns final review integrity and binds consumed artifacts; these mechanical checks do not establish legal correctness or substantive adequacy.

Evaluation tooling copies selected existing artifacts locally, pins the actual product ZIP version and hash, records host/model/tool observation limits and binds any actual assessment to exact final-answer bytes. Comparison withholds workflow labels in a separate assessor directory while preserving content; file integrity cannot certify execution authenticity or professional quality.

The local helper validates the managed or standalone run, output boundary and record revision. Model mismatch, unknown identity and model/session changes never block work; legacy blocked records never block continuation, read leaves saved artifacts unchanged, and subsequent writes retain prior versions. UI confirmation is bound to the server-side run by a random expiring token. Host-reported identity, user-confirmed selection and unknown identity remain distinct. The UI does not switch host models. Chat fallback uses the same helper, with no new service, account, credentials, automatic anonymization or automatic model switching.
